errors.text_span: The pie chart compares the proportion of projects that have completed inspections, are under site inspection completion, are under design completion, and those that do not meet the city inspection standards.
errors.evidence: The chart represents the level of preparation and qualification of contractors and designers for Passive House standard projects, not inspection statuses or city standards.
The green sector represents 51%, but it corresponds to 'Няма достатъчно подготвени и квалифицирани специалисти за изграждането на сграда според стандарта Пасивна къща,' not completed inspections.
The red sector represents 23%, but it corresponds to 'Само част от изпълнителите/проектантите са подготвени да изпълняват проекти според стандарта Пасивна сграда,' not site inspection completion.

The purple sector represents 23%, but it corresponds to 'Само малка част от изпълнителите/проектантите са подготвени да изпълняват проекти според стандарта Пасивна сграда, а голям брой специалисти имат нужда от обучения за изпълнението на стандарта,' not design completion.

errors.text_span: 3% do not meet the city inspection standards
errors.evidence: The blue sector represents 3%, but it corresponds to 'Подготвени и добре квалифицирани са за да изпълняват проекти според стандарта Пасивна сграда,' not failing city inspection standards.

errors.text_span: The remaining 77% of projects are under site inspection completion.
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect and does not align with the chart structure or data. The chart does not group sectors into a 'remaining 77%' category.
The description does not mention that the chart represents the level of preparation and qualification of contractors and designers for Passive House standard projects.
The description omits the presence of a legend explaining the sectors and the percentage labels within each sector.
The description does not mention the colors of the sectors (blue, red, purple, green) or their corresponding labels.
